notes.title: Changelog for Project XMAS 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[b]From now it's easier to find a key and a exit from labirynth :[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed player spawn position closer to the doors
[*] Now the [b]labirynth is a little bit smaller[/b]
[/list]
Other new Features :
[olist]
[*] Added ability to change [b]VHS Effects strenght[/b]
[*] New variants of walls with some captions
[*] Lowered a little bit [b]in-game VHS Sounds[/b]
[*] Improved Shelf model
[*] For now there is no duplicates of notes - only one type of note per whole maze
[*] Added Audio zone near the doors
[/olist]

Bugfixes :
[olist]
[*] Fixed problem with player spawning inside the wall
[*] The pause menu now stopping the game time
[*] [strike]The achivements works properly[/strike]
[*] Fixed bug where the pause menu was overlayed on options
[*] Fixed bug with VHS Effect on reading note screen
[*] Now the game settings are autosaved to file
[*] Fixed problem with stopped time after returning to main menu
[*] The loading screen works better
[*] Corrected the roof material and position
[*] Fixed doors material
[*] Fixed pages spawn rotation
[*] Fixed batteries spawn rotation
[*] There was missing "SLP" text in loading screen
[*] Fixed problem with snow footsteps in tunnel behind the doors
[/olist]

notes.title: 1.0.2.1 Bugfix for Project XMAS
notes.notes:
[h3]In this bugfix there was a problem with completing the game :[/h3]
- Fixed mystical doors open animation
- Fixed problem with [b]picking up the key[/b]
- The [b]flashlight is now a little bit brighter[/b]
- Fixed problem with some [b]Steam achievements[/b]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 of Project XMAS
notes.notes:
[h3]In this path I focused on your reviews and bugs you founded.[/h3]

- New, better [b]main menu[/b] with game options (audio, graphics)
- Fixed player's raycasting for [b]easier items collecting[/b].
- Fixed AI problem with [b]seeing through walls[/b].
- Fixed AI "Agony" state when the player "attack" monster with [b]flashlight beam[/b]
- New shorter intro at the start of the game.

[b]And fixed many smaller bugs founded in 1.0.1[/b]
